answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that vests slowly, so mass-producing fakes costs real capital. Like a pearl formed grain by grain, reputation accrues only through a long history of honest attestations. An attacker can spin up mirrors of the same puppet logic, but peers compare behavioral fingerprints: identical response patterns across supposed strangers flag the flock. Like a raven colony recognizing an intruder by its call, stake-weighted voting then amplifies only identities whose history proves they are singular.
